issue.title: format_cents doesn't group thousands
issue.body:
Large amounts are hard to read because `format_cents` doesn't use thousands separators:

    >>> format_cents(123456789)
    '$1234567.89'

**Expected**

- `format_cents(123456789)` returns `'$1,234,567.89'`.
- Negative amounts work the same way: `format_cents(-123456)` returns `'-$1,234.56'`.
- Amounts under $1,000 look exactly as they do now.

Please add tests.

---
